negative_control: The same harness against the pre-fix Codex build (hook on tick_local_hand) failed 'BreakDelay cooldown 0 clears the same line much faster than ordinary': enabled took 21 and 20 ticks, equal to ordinary 21 and 21.
root_cause: A singleplayer window is a client of its integrated server. Its held-button breaks run through remote_mining and its own destroy_delay, not Clicks/tick_local_hand, so the earlier hook never ran on the window and BreakDelay changed nothing; the earlier on/off check passed by timing noise at the reach cap.

isolation.data: scratch HORIZON_HOME, launcher, XDG, TEMP; no accounts, existing worlds or multiplayer

limitations: BreakDelay speed is measured in game ticks over a four-block creative line at the sampling resolution of the control wait (several ticks); it is not an exact per-tick trace.
Survival no-insta-break is checked for one stone block with a netherite pickaxe; other tools, blocks and enchantments are not swept.
Physical mouse input is exercised through the control socket press path; the window mouse hook is compiled and planned but not driven by a physical device.
AutoRespawn's Waypoints effect is not migrated (that module is absent); the death-waypoint effect is a no-op.
The stock launcher native-build flow was not run for this snapshot. Full Meteor parity is not claimed; the other 24 retained policies remain inactive.
